image_description: A medium shot of a Blue Monkey (Cercopithecus mitis) perched on a tree branch in an enclosure. The monkey has dark grey/blue fur, a lighter chest, and a distinctive white ruff around its face with a dark cap. It is holding onto a vertical branch with one hand and resting on a horizontal branch. Thick ropes are visible in the background and foreground, suggesting a zoo or sanctuary setting.

Eyes are forward-facing. While resolution limits precise iris color confirmation, they appear dark/brown consistent with the species.

Ears are small and partially obscured by the facial ruff, consistent with the taxonomy.
